---
name: Feature request
about: Something Plume should do and does not
labels: needs-triage
---

**Read the non-goals first.** `docs/architecture.md` has a list, and it is meant
seriously: cloud transcription, AI post-processing, diarization, meeting
recording, cross-platform. Those are declined whatever the quality of the
argument, and saying so up front is fairer than saying it after you have written
one.

**What you are trying to do**, rather than the feature you have in mind for it.

**What you do today instead.**

**Why a flag or a setting is not enough.** This app has stayed small by adding
capability rarely. The settings window, the biggest recent addition, deliberately
exposed nothing the daemon could not already do.
